<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: center"><B>SUPERIOR SILVER MINES, INC.<BR>
ARTICLES OF DOMESTICATION</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.6pt">Superior Silver
Mines, Inc. makes these Articles Of Domestication in accordance with the provisions of Nevada Revised Statutes section 92A.270, as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.6pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify">1.&nbsp;Superior Silver Mines, Inc.
(the &ldquo;Corporation&rdquo;) was first organized as a corporation pursuant to the laws of the State of Idaho on January&nbsp;22, 1962.
The Corporation was not chartered elsewhere after its incorporation. However, the name of the Corporation as it now exists, Superior Silver
Mines, Inc., was formerly &ldquo;Superior Mines Company&rdquo;.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify">2.&nbsp;The name of the domesticated
entity immediately before filing these Articles was, and is, Superior Silver Mines, Inc.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify">3.&nbsp;The name of the domestic entity
as set forth in its charter document was Superior Mines Company, with its name formally subsequently changed to Superior Silver Mines,
Inc. The Corporation was formed as a corporation, and remains a corporation to and including the date of these Articles.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify">4.&nbsp;The principal place of business
of Corporation immediately before filing these Articles was the State of Idaho.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.6pt">These Articles
Of Domestication were duly approved by the Board Of Directors of Superior Silver Mines, Inc. by Resolutions of the Board dated December&nbsp;21,
2010. The undersigned, President of Superior Silver Mines, Inc., is duly authorized by the Board Of Directors of the Corporation to execute
these Articles Of Domestication.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.6pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify">Dated this 21 st Day of December&nbsp;2010.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>
